principles.plot_contract: every public plot_* API must have one deterministic documented gallery case
principles.plot_noncontract: not every result object requires a plotting API
principles.failure_semantics: prefer explicit failure or explicit status over silent scientific repair
principles.serialization: portable scientific snapshots must disclose nonportable fields rather than hide them

postures.canonical_candidate: recommended workflow entry point under review for a 1.0 stability promise
postures.supported_candidate: supported public API under review for a 1.0 stability promise
postures.diagnostic_candidate: public audit, sensitivity, validation, or diagnostic API; supported but not a model-selection oracle
postures.experimental: supported API with an explicitly narrower interpretation or validation boundary; no 1.0 stability promise yet
postures.compatibility: public compatibility/backend-specific route retained deliberately; not an accidental duplicate
postures.result_object_candidate: public Result container whose schema must be considered before any 1.0 promise

known_intentional_parallel_routes.reason: native estimator versus explicit FDApy compatibility backend; not treated as accidental duplication
common-grid multivariate FDA and native sparse paired-planar FDA have different observation contracts
